description.5610: The Senate (or Senat) of AGH University is the body responsible for approving and awarding the title/degree of Doktor (or Doctor) Honoris Causa (DHC) or Doktor Honoris Causa AGH. This includes approving the awarding, conferring the title, and being involved in the decision process related to assigning DHC titles. They also hold ceremonial sessions for the awarding of the Doktor Honoris Causa.
description.287: The "Baza Danych o Autorach i Publikacjach" (Database of Authors and Publications) is a database specific to AGH University. It is managed and maintained by AGH and contains information about authors and their publications affiliated with the university. The database serves as an internal system for archiving staff, students, and publications of AGH, tracking the research output of AGH authors. It is an official informational resource of AGH University and a part of its information system.
description.544: Poczta AGH is the official email system provided and operated by AGH University for its staff, students, members, and departments.
description.2760: The Biblioteka Główna AGH (AGH Main Library) implements, uses, and manages its library operations and resources with the ALMA library system.
description.533: AGH University provides and maintains the "Open AGH" initiative, which is a collection of open educational resources. This initiative is also known as "OPEN AGH – Otwarte Zasoby Edukacyjne" and is specifically designed for public access. It's an AGH-sponsored initiative that promotes open educational resources and forms part of the services offered by AGH University. AGH is responsible for developing, maintaining, and providing these open educational resources.
description.292: Biuletyn AGH is a publication of AGH University of Science and Technology. It's published and distributed by AGH and is considered an official Publication related to the university. It can be described as official publication or newsletter.
description.4430: CeLiID AGH maintains and manages the Webinaroteka, a resource that provides access to recorded webinars and e-learning materials. The Webinaroteka serves as a webinar library and repository managed by CeLiID AGH, offering a collection of webinars that CELIID AGH likely contributes content to.
description.619: The online store, referred to as "Sklep Internetowy AGH" in Polish, is owned, operated by, or associated with AGH University. It serves as the official online store and service of the university.
description.1115: The Main Library is an integral part of AGH University, functioning as its central library. It provides a range of services to the university's students and faculty and is a key element of the university's infrastructure.
description.1039: AGH University offers housing to its students through the AGH University Student Campus, which is an integral part of the university's infrastructure. The Student Campus provides dormitory services and accommodation for students attending AGH University. It functions as the primary student housing affiliated with the university.
description.6117: The Sekcja Obsługi Organizacji Studenckich (Section supporting student organizations), is a section within, a part of, and is under the Dział Spraw Studenckich AGH (Student Affairs Department). The Student Affairs Department includes the Student Organizations Section.
description.6119: The Sekcja Wypłat i Rozliczeń Stypendiów (Scholarship Payments and Settlements Section) is a part of or a section within the Dział Spraw Studenckich (Student Affairs Department) at AGH University.
description.293: The "Biuletyn Informacyjny Pracowników AGH" (Employee Information Bulletin) is an internal publication of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) distributed to its staff. It serves as an information bulletin published by AGH for its employees.
description.1163: The Welcome Point is a service, facility, or unit within AGH University. It is offered by the university to provide support services for students, particularly new students. One key area of assistance offered by the Welcome Point is information about transportation.
description.4641: The Centrum Obsługi Kształcenia (Educational Support Center) manages and supports postgraduate studies (Studia Podyplomowe) programs, providing administrative services related to them.
description.1975: AGH University of Science and Technology (Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza) manages and maintains a database named "Baza Danych o Autorach i Publikacjach AGH" (Database of Authors and Publications of AGH). This database contains information about AGH's researchers, authors, and their publications affiliated with the university. The purpose of the database is to track and provide a resource for publications and authors connected to AGH.
description.1052: The Careers Centre, a part of AGH University, provides career support and services to students of AGH University. It functions as a dedicated service offered by the university to assist its students with their career development.
description.2058: Poczta AGH is the official email system provided and managed by AGH University (Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza) for internal communications of its students and staff.
description.1230: The Office for Doctoral Students' Affairs is a service, support office, part, sub-unit, and department within the AGH University Doctoral School.
description.290: The Main Library (Biblioteka Główna AGH) is the central library facility and a part of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH). It provides library services to the AGH community and is considered the main library of AGH.
description.2286: Dział Dostępności AGH (Accessibility Department) is a department within AGH University responsible for accessibility. It is part of the AGH University structure and dedicated to improving accessibility.
description.614: The Senat AGH (also referred to as the Senate) serves as the governing body of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH). It functions as a committee within AGH and is responsible for governing the university.
description.2050: AGH University of Science and Technology (Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza) provides and manages the OPEN AGH initiative, which is an open educational resource platform. AGH offers educational resources through OPEN AGH and maintains the platform. The university also manages the Open AGH program to promote open educational resources.
description.2246: The Biuro Rektora (Rector's Office) is a part of the central administration of AGH University. It is a central administrative unit within the university.
description.3901: The 'Biuro Obsługi Spraw Studenckich' is a part of the 'Dział Spraw Studenckich AGH', functioning under its supervision and providing services within it.
description.1912: The Wydział Hutniczy (Faculty of Metallurgy) is a faculty within Akademia Górnicza (AGH). It is also referred to as Wydział Hutniczy and is a part of Akademia Górnicza.
description.1872: The Akademia Górnicza-Hutnicza (AGH) grants or awards the title/degree of Doktor Honoris Causa. This relationship is described as AGH granting/awarding the Doktor Honoris Causa degree. The title/degree is also described as being awarded *by* AGH.
description.1979: The Biuletyn Informacyjny Pracowników AGH is a publication of AGH University, also known as Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza. It is distributed and managed by the university and is also referred to as Biuletyn Informacyjny Pracowników. The publication is also referred to as the "Biuletyn Informacyjny Pracowników AGH". A longer name for AGH University is AGH University of Science and Technology.
description.6275: The Dean's Office (Dziekanat) is an integral administrative part of the Doctoral School (Szkoła Doktorska) at AGH University. It manages educational affairs and provides administrative support to the Doctoral School.
description.616: AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH) has a long-standing, 20-year collaborative partnership with Shibaura Institute of Technology (SIT). SIT is considered a key international partner of AGH. This partnership involves student internships, joint research endeavors, and academic exchange programs. The institutions maintain a formal partnership and collaboration agreement.
description.9610: The Senat AGH (Senate of AGH) is responsible for awarding the title of Honorary Consul of AGH (Konsul Honorowy AGH) to individuals. The Senat AGH also approves the appointment of individuals to this position.
description.2075: The Senat of AGH University (also referred to as Senat AGH) or Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza (AKADEMIA GÓRNICZO-HUTNICZA) is the highest administrative governing body of the university, responsible for governing its operation.
description.2077: Sklep Internetowy AGH is an online store operated by or affiliated with AGH University (Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza).  AGH University owns and operates the online store, providing it as a service.
description.738: The Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics (also referred to as Wydział Inżynierii Materiałowej i Ceramiki) is a constituent faculty of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH). It is a faculty within AGH.
description.6070: The Sekcja Wypłat i Rozliczeń Stypendiów (Section for Scholarship Payments and Settlements), also known as the Scholarship Payments and Settlements Section, is a subunit or section within the Dział Spraw Studenckich (Student Affairs Department) at AGH.
description.3855: The Biuletyn Informacyjny Pracowników AGH (AGH employee bulletin) publishes lists of individuals who have been awarded the title of Doktor Honoris Causa by AGH. It serves as a source of information regarding recipients of this honorary degree from the university.
description.2552: The Akademickie Centrum Materiałów i Nanotechnologii (ACMiN) is a part of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). AGH UST is a Research University within the IDUB (Inicjatywa Doskonałości – Uczelnia Badawcza) program, also referred to as "Uczelnia Badawcza IDUB AGH". ACMiN participates in and contributes to the goals of the AGH IDUB Research University program.  ACMiN likely benefits from the resources, funding, and research projects provided or funded by the Uczelnia Badawcza IDUB AGH initiative.
description.1058: The Centre for International Affairs (CIA) is an administrative division and a department within AGH University. It manages and is responsible for international affairs and activities at the university.
